scope: Small prompts for interactive generation, programming, scientific reasoning and code editing.

cases.name: square
cases.prompt: 请只输出 Python 代码，编写函数 square(x)，返回 x * x，不要解释。

cases.name: general-code
cases.prompt: Write Python code for merge_sorted(a, b), merging two sorted lists without changing either input. Include a short explanation of time complexity.

cases.name: science
cases.prompt: Explain why subtracting nearly equal floating-point numbers can lose relative precision. Give a small numerical example and a Python implementation of a more stable alternative for computing sqrt(1+x)-1 when x is small.
